pages.title: Executable Catalog
pages.text: Bulk consumables are no longer inert tooltips. Boat/ferry/teleport tickets and Diyuan tokens call travel or realm entry; spirit-gather disks deploy free aura fields; invitations, tax slips, patrol seals and sect tokens hit auction, reputation and identity; map scraps write real chronicle discoveries.

pages.title: Craft Fuels
pages.text: Talisman ink is required by all 24 talisman recipes. Spirit sand extends free formation duration only after a successful activation. Wind-feather raft blueprints mint a travel ticket when Spirit Transformation, a formed dock and materials are ready. Failures refund key costs.

pages.title: Heals and Wards
pages.text: Minor detox, mortal medicine, thunder wards, yin protection, smoke screens and sound beacons all run server-side. No-benefit or stronger-status cases refuse consumption. Pure materials remain tooltip carriers by design.

pages.title: Authority
pages.text: Every consume is server-authoritative: validate → reserve/spend → apply → refund on failure. Travel items honor region vs secret-realm namespaces separately.
